coast._note: Wave 5b (V4): a contract zone on the coast, for the AAV support's tests and the debug path (--zone coast). Its sea is the terrain preset's (amphibious_coast: 360 m of water, 14 m deep at the edge; ZoneDef picks the side), and the second insertion and extraction points sit by the north, west and east edges so the south is the only side it can pick. "coast": the company's LHD lies offshore lhd_m from the sea's edge, lhd_along_m along it (Lhd).
